test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which country does Dominic Thiem, the winner of the 2020 U.S. Open Men’s Championships, represent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Austria.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dominic Thiem won his first Grand Slam title at the US Open 2020.
 
• **He is an Austrian tennis player.**
 
• He defeated Alexander Zverev.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Spain's Rafael Nadal won the Australian Open Men's Singles final on 30 January 2022.

 
• Australian tennis player Ashleigh Barty defeated American Danielle Collins to win the Australian Open women's title on 29 January 2022.
 
• French tennis player Gael Monfils has won the men’s singles event of the 2022 Adelaide International 1 to claim the 11th ATP title of his career.
